dataset.name: ARC-AGI-2 public training split only
dataset.official_evaluation_downloaded: unpacked individually: false; one temporary upstream archive contained evaluation blobs
dataset.pre_run_training_json_schema_audit_inclu: yes, rectangular/color-domain checks only; no input-output comparisons or outcome scoring

task_split.method: sort training task IDs by SHA256('phase13g-v1:' + task_id); assign first 600, next 200, final 200

dsl.translation_inference: rare-color anchor search using up to 16 deterministic source positions; all demos then replayed exactly
dsl.task_success: exact grid equality for every test pair in task
dsl.unknown_or_unmatched: retain as unsupported; do not force a family or infer a program

trace.trace_success: candidate program fits every demonstration pair exactly
trace.primary_trace_quality: proportion of emitted traces meeting schema and independent exact-fit checks

invariants.is_definition: frequency * consistency * generality using existing core.Invariant strength; family breadth is operational transform signatures only

skills.promotion: candidate invariant is formed into a reusable program skill only after internal transfer split validation; require >=3 applicable transfer tasks and a passing existing qualify_candidate gate; transfer split never tunes DSL, threshold, or candidate order
skills.scv: existing SkillCandidate SCV formula; reuse=min(1, successful transfer tasks/SkillConfig.reuse_norm=10), abstraction_gain=max(0, mean positive B1 candidate trials saved/10 programs), transfer_score=successes/applicable exact-demo-fit attempts; creation cost=existing default 0.1; no prior transfer counted as observed evidence

transfer.near: same recognized program signature on a distinct task ID
transfer.cross_family: same recognized signature on a distinct observable structural bucket; reported only when both buckets are independently observed
transfer.structural: same transformation remains exact under changed dimensions/colors/object counts; post hoc categorized descriptively and not a primary pass gate
transfer.accuracy_unit: task exact-match across all test pairs

reasoning_cost.asft_order: skills sorted by discovery support, then remaining fixed DSL order; every trial still requires exact demo validation

arms.ASFT: trace-mined invariants, transfer-validated skills, reusable skill-first ordering, 3-candidate budget
arms.B1_NO_LEARNING: fixed-order DSL search, no learned records
arms.B2_MEMORY_SKILL_STORE: episodic discovery traces ranked by nearest non-label grid-statistic distance; no invariant abstraction; exact-demo verification required
arms.B3_RANDOM_SKILL_CREATION: seed-keyed random permutation of the same qualified operator pool; no invariant-strength or SCV ordering
arms.B4_COMPRESSION_PROXY: exact repeated trace-signature compression only; no generalized motif mining; not canonical DreamCoder

growth.capability_unit: independently validated reusable transform skill; capability groups require >=2 skills and successful transfer
growth.ig: existing Phase 13E compute_ig pathway and frozen weights; unavailable if required validated capabilities or components are missing; no ARC-specific replacement formula

stats.confidence_interval: paired bootstrap by task ID, 10000 resamples, RNG seed 1307
stats.nulls: retain and report; no imputation or outcome-based threshold changes
stats.primary_comparison: ASFT vs each B1-B4 on holdout exact task accuracy and candidate trials

constraints: No claim that ASFT solves ARC
No claim of general ARC-AGI-2 score; public official evaluation untouched
No edits to Phase 13C-13F artifacts or metrics
No training on transfer/holdout outputs before their designated use
Report DSL coverage ceiling and unsupported requested families explicitly

run_integrity_addendum.attempt_01: holdout predictions generated in memory; evidence write failed at missing task_id; no outcome rows persisted or inspected
run_integrity_addendum.software_fix: serialize discovery task_id and set program-order stability unavailable for unsupported tasks (excluded from preregistered stability denominator)
